test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.

There have been __numerous__ attempts made by the citizens to restore parity.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "numerous attempts" is already correct in this context, as it conveys the idea of a large number of attempts without any ambiguity or unnecessary emphasis.
 
• Using "most numerous," "more numerous," or "quite numerous" would change the meaning or structure of the sentence, making them less appropriate than the existing phrasing.
 
• Thus, there is no need for any substitution.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"There have been numerous attempts made by the citizens to restore parity."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "Most numerous"** – This would imply that the attempts are the greatest in comparison to others, which doesn't fit well in the context of this sentence.
 
• **3: "More numerous"** – This would suggest a comparison to fewer attempts, which isn't the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• **4: "Quite numerous"** – This would add an unnecessary modifier and make the sentence sound less formal.
 
• **No substitution** – The existing phrasing "numerous attempts" is appropriate and doesn't require any change.
